name: @builderforce/hono-wildcard-path
description: THE way to read what a Hono route's trailing `*` matched: Hono never exposes the wildcard as a named param, and every hand-rolled `c.req.path.replace(...)` mangles a key that repeats a segment. Derives the remainder from the matched route pattern itself and decodes each segment. Shared by the API's file, asset, hook and weight routes and the legacy worker's file router. Source-only and dependency-free: it types the two request fields it reads structurally, so Hono's Context satisfies it without being imported.
